name: In Series: Inbaku Kankin Choukyou
original_name: 淫シリーズ　淫縛監禁調教
source:
What does "confinement" mean? Ryosuke thinks about it. Yes, just do it. There won't be any problems. His target girls are Mika and Saki....

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
何谓“监禁”？良介在心中暗自思索。没错，直接动手便是，绝不会出什么岔子。这一回，他锁定的猎物是美佳与纱希……

[摘自ErogeShop]
